issue_request: FHIR-7438 asked for help text in the Flags column after the Conformance logical view made it hard to remember that ?! denotes a modifier element; the final Published/Persuasive resolution was to add a footer to the table.
initial_application: No migrated git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7438. The Jira comment says to add the footer per task 7220; FHIR-7220 records svn revision 6440, which corresponds in migrated git history to commit 1530406411 adding a documentation/footer row to generated hierarchical tables.
additional_context: The old Conformance resource was renamed/replaced later, but the issue was about generic table-rendering documentation rather than conformance semantics. Current documentation links to formats.html, formats.html has a Key to Flags section, conformance-rules.html explains ?! as the isModifier flag, and resource-notes examples show the Documentation for this format footer/link.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested help text/footer behavior is already present in current source and generated-table documentation surfaces.
